corrections.reason: The printed text at the end of Column 1 Line 8 is clearly the two-letter word 'ሂዱ ፡' ('they went'), which Stage 1 misread/expanded as 'ሂደው ፡'.

In Classical Ge'ez construct state before a proper noun ('the face of Jehoshaphat', 2 Kings 3:14), the form is 1st-order construct 'ገጸ ፡ ኢዮሳፍጥ', and visually the character 'ጸ' has two straight legs with no 7th-order ring.
Visually on Line 36 the word is 'ሕዋሳቶቿ ፡' (three glyphs 'ሳቶቿ' on this line) with no extra 'ዋ' character printed after 'ቿ'.
The printed glyph in the book is clearly 2nd-order 'ሁነ' (with the right-side horizontal stroke of 'ሁ'), an authentic archaic Andemta spelling that should be preserved.
As on the preceding line, the printed glyph at the start of Line 3 is clearly 2nd-order 'ሁነ' rather than 'ሆነ'.
